name: bxlapp
summary:
bxlapp brings your building projects from the bxlapp web platform into mixed reality on Meta Quest.

Load a project from your account and walk through it in your own room — at true 1:1 scale, embedded into your real surroundings through passthrough. Or shrink it to a 1:10 model and look at the whole building from above, like a physical model on your table.

What you can do:

• Walk through your building at 1:1, or study it as a 1:10 table model
• See the real sun: the light follows the coordinates and true
